status: INTERNAL PREPARATION ONLY — NO BOEING/SPIRIT EFFECT MEASURED
purpose: Predeclare how a future partner-authorized pilot would measure operational effect without converting synthetic/public-analog performance into Boeing/Spirit outcome claims.
primary_measurement_principles: freeze the comparison design and exclusions before intervention
retain denominators, missingness and adverse/null results
separate detection quality from operational outcome
report uncertainty and practical materiality, not only point estimates
record concurrent process, staffing, rate, supplier, design and tooling changes as potential confounders
do not convert time saved or defects detected into financial savings without partner-approved costing/attribution
do not extrapolate beyond the evaluated site/process/supplier/configuration population

candidate_primary_endpoints.name: repeat_nonconformance_rate
candidate_primary_endpoints.required_ground_truth: partner NCR/RCCA taxonomy and repeat-event linkage

candidate_primary_endpoints.name: quality_action_closure_latency
candidate_primary_endpoints.required_ground_truth: partner authoritative open/close timestamps and closure criteria

candidate_primary_endpoints.name: evidence_retrieval_latency
candidate_primary_endpoints.required_ground_truth: predefined retrieval tasks and authoritative evidence target

secondary_endpoints_requiring_stricter_a.name: preventable_rework_or_inspection_hours
secondary_endpoints_requiring_stricter_a.constraint: May be reported only if partner predefines what counts as preventable, supplies authoritative time data and approves attribution logic.

secondary_endpoints_requiring_stricter_a.name: schedule_impact
secondary_endpoints_requiring_stricter_a.constraint: May be reported only with partner-defined schedule baseline, event linkage and confounder handling.

secondary_endpoints_requiring_stricter_a.name: financial_savings_or_cost_avoidance
secondary_endpoints_requiring_stricter_a.constraint: Not a default endpoint. Requires partner finance/program authority, approved costing inputs and causal attribution; otherwise prohibited.

comparison_design_options.limitation: cannot establish prospective operational effect by itself

comparison_design_options.strength: tests live timeliness and ground-truth agreement without controlling production
comparison_design_options.limitation: cannot establish intervention effect if workflow is unchanged

comparison_design_options.strength: can estimate operational change when baseline is stable and confounders are tracked
preferred when partner can support a comparable untreated workflow/site/supplier/time block
comparison_design_options.limitation: requires comparability assessment and sufficient sample size

preanalysis_record_required: materiality threshold for each primary endpoint
sample-size/precision rationale appropriate to available data
effect_gate_closure_requirements: at least one predeclared primary endpoint measured against an agreed baseline/comparator
independent reviewer verifies the effect analysis
claim wording does not exceed measured scope
contact_gate_effect: NONE. This protocol prepares measured_effect_size evidence but does not satisfy it; measured_effect_size remains missing until a real authorized pilot produces an independently reviewed effect estimate against a predeclared baseline/comparator.
claims_boundary: This is an internal measurement protocol, not measured effect evidence. It does not establish Boeing/Spirit defect reduction, quality improvement, schedule improvement, rework reduction, savings, production effectiveness, adoption, causality, or remediation probability.
